extracted.intended_audience: developers and project teams wanting to use arXiv public APIs (both commercial and noncommercial projects)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for projects (commercial and noncommercial) that access arXiv metadata and full text via arXiv public APIs or bulk data pipelines, including documentation, branding, attribution, and when to apply for closer collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercial projects requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Commercial projects that utilize arXiv’s APIs should review relevant documentation first. Read about our public APIs or other bulk data pipelines, review arXiv's brand use guidelines, and consider becoming an arXiv affiliate before embarking on the project. This includes any project created as a product for sale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commercial projects must review API and bulk-pipeline documentation and brand guidelines and should consider formal affiliation (arXiv affiliate) prior to developing products for sale that use arXiv data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent noncommercial project criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Independent, noncommercial, and open access projects that: utilize arXiv’s public APIs; do not require assistance from arXiv; and do not use the names “arXiv”, “arXiv.org”, “arXiv Labs”, “arXivLabs” or associated logos, web addresses and colors; and are free, open access, and/or intended for research or educational purposes ... are considered entirely independent from arXiv.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To be considered independent and noncommercial you must satisfy all listed conditions (use public APIs, no arXiv assistance, no branding that implies endorsement, and free/open research/educational intent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgment of arXiv data usage
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv requests that you acknowledge arXiv data usage with this statement on your product: “Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the exact acknowledgment statement on your product as requested by arXiv; this applies to independent noncommercial projects and is reiterated under 'For all API users.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Branding and endorsement prohibition
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not brand your project with arXiv’s names (“arXiv”, “arXiv.org”, “arXiv Labs”, “arXivLabs”) or use associated logos, web addresses, and colors in a manner that implies arXiv’s endorsement of the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This prohibition applies to all API users (commercial and noncommercial). Avoid any use of arXiv trademarks or visual identity that could create a perception of endorsement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required documentation review (Terms and manuals)
rubrics_metrics.description: For all API users: Familiarize yourself with arXiv’s API Terms of Use. Review the API Basics and the API User Manual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before using the API, read the Terms of Use and both the Basics and User Manual to understand permitted uses, technical details, and any restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage with the API user community
rubrics_metrics.description: Check out the arXiv API user community to learn, ask questions, and share information about your project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the community as a resource for implementation help, best practices, and to avoid duplicating existing efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review additional interoperability resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Review these additional resources about arXiv’s interoperability: arXiv’s identifier scheme, bulk data access information, and the Open Archives Initiative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult these resources for details on identifiers, bulk metadata/full-text access options, and standards-related interoperability considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to apply for arXivLabs collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: If your project positively benefits the arXiv community and requires significant assistance from arXiv staff, learn more about how to apply to become an arXivLabs collaborator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects needing close partnership/support (beyond public API use) should consider the arXivLabs collaboration pathway and follow the application guidance linked from the page.
